item.text: {"paper_id":"paper069","profile_id":"neuroscience","relevance":3,"evidence_quote":"This nationwide cohort study demonstrates a clear day-of-the-week variation in hospital admissions for ischemic stroke among patients with AF, with fewer admissions on weekends than on weekdays.","rationale":"The study directly examines ischemic stroke, an explicitly listed interest, characterizing admission patterns and identifying timely care as a potential target for improving stroke outcomes.","scope_ambiguous":false,"ambiguity_note":""}
